title: Super Washing Machines
goal: Solve Super Washing Machines: Find minimum number of operations to make each washing machine have same number of dresses.
strategy: Find minimum number of operations to make each washing machine have same number of dresses.
edgeCases: If total load is not divisible by machine count, balancing is impossible; both local surplus and cross-boundary flow constrain moves.
inputRules: machines must be a non-empty array, e.g. [1,0,5]
